# Static exact-node-ID partition of tests/test_final_research_map.py (Issue #180-A).
# Format: "<shard> <pytest node ID>"; the node ID is everything after the first space.
# Every collected node ID appears exactly once; within a shard, IDs are ordered by
# expected duration so the longest tests start first, and the first 2*c IDs
# (c = max(2, n // 2 // 4), pytest-xdist's initial per-worker chunk for -n 2)
# alternate into two balanced starting chunks so both workers begin with large tests.
# Membership balanced from CI run 42326544166 (--durations=20) and local serial durations x2.4;
# order within shards from local sharded -n 2 durations.
